summary: Join our Agricultural Cooperatives and Associations Course to gain essential knowledge and skills for effective teamwork and sustainable farming practices.
lede: Agricultural cooperative and association training equips cooperative leaders and rural-development practitioners to strengthen member-driven organizations. It covers democratic governance, financial accountability, member engagement, business planning, and connections to markets and value chains. Learners apply these skills to improve cooperative sustainability, manage risks, and deliver useful services to members.
audience: Cooperative and association leaders (chairpersons, secretaries, treasurers)
Cooperative union managers and board members
Rural finance and microfinance institution officers
Value chain and market linkage professionals
modules: Principles and Models of Agricultural Cooperatives
Market Access and Value Chain Integration
